stdout:
Usage: sllm-store start [OPTIONS]

  Start the gRPC server.

Options:
  --host TEXT                     Host
  --port INTEGER                  Port
  --storage-path TEXT             Storage path (default: $STORAGE_PATH or
                                  ~/models/)
  --num-thread INTEGER            Number of I/O threads
  --chunk-size TEXT               Chunk size, e.g., 4KB, 1MB, 1GB
  --mem-pool-size TEXT            Memory pool size, e.g., 1GB, 4GB, 1TB
  --disk-size TEXT                Disk size, e.g., 1GB, 4GB, 1TB
  --registration-required BOOLEAN
                                  Require registration before loading model
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
scope: Actual installed CLI help/import only; no Store initialization, GPU or model
